headline: Get ready in advance: barring surprises, China may see 3 major changes starting in October
summary: China may see three major changes starting in October, according to the report. The changes relate to interest subsidies, loans, mortgages, wages and subsidy amounts for ordinary families.
why: Changes to household interest subsidies, mortgages and wages affect consumer spending and credit demand in China's economy.
